title: Keep answer-generated distinct from task-complete
narrative: Producing an answer is not the same as finishing the task when verification is required. Accepts inspiration requirement 5[^insp-r05].
implementation: `OutcomeContract` in `mechaharness.outcome_contract` distinguishes `answer_generated`, `verified`, `complete`, and `failed`. `DefaultVerificationPolicy` selects the strongest sufficient oracle and gates completion through the outcome contract when `require_verification` is set.
validation: Kind `verification_outcome_gate`. Soft expects: answer without verification stays `answer_generated`; verification pass yields `complete`. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`.
